description: Tracks active open-source AI agent repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: The agent that grows with you
⌥ Coding agent with the IDE wired in. Built by Stencil Labs.

Open-source, self-hosted alternative to OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse, Grok Bot, Manus Cue and Claude Cowork. AI agents, each with a virtual machine on your PC with a desktop, a shell, files, memory and skills that stay, invisible to anti-bots. Any model on OpenRouter.

Open-source desktop SQL workspace with 3 built-in database drivers and 16 shipped plugins, including SQL Server, DuckDB, ClickHouse and Redis. Built-in MCP server for Claude, Cursor and Devin, SQL notebooks and visual EXPLAIN.
A persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session.
Agentic development harness for Claude Code — SPEC-driven plan/run/sync, TRUST 5 quality gates, model+effort routing, and Claude×GLM multi-LLM cost control. Single Go binary, 16 languages, zero deps.
pi coding agent in a technicolor web trenchcoat
A compounding agent OS for recursive agents. Also an open source alternative to Grok Bot and Meta's Muse.
GTM agent for technical founders. Pay-per-result. Two surfaces: terminal CLI + local web dashboard.
Building blocks for frontier OpenAI agents in Rust. Nanocodex empowers you with Codex-level performance anywhere.
Matt Pocock 技能集的中文翻译版 — 地道中文，原汁原味的技术术语。基于 mattpocock/skills 复刻。每日中午12点钟同步

nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own — one agent with a name and a face that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.
Persistent memory for Claude Code — identity, context, and continuity across sessions

MCP server for OpenRouter — chat with 300+ LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT), analyze images / audio / video, generate images / speech / music / video (Veo 3.1, Sora, Seedance, Wan) from Claude Desktop, Cursor, Kiro, VS Code.
'Personal AGI' that thinks on its own. Autonomous cognitive cycle, earned autonomy, 60+ tools. It decides what to do without being told.
